title: Sherry Cask Whisky
subtitle: Sherry casks and Scotch, 1800s to now
description: How the British sherry trade put Spanish wine casks into Scottish distilleries, and how distillers kept getting them after Spain stopped shipping sherry in cask. Four pours.

pours.name: Glenmorangie The Original
pours.notes: Matured only in ex-bourbon casks. Keep a little in your glass to come back to.

pours.name: Glenmorangie Lasanta
pours.notes: The same distillery and age as pour one, with its last two years in oloroso and Pedro Ximénez casks. Taste the two side by side.

pours.name: Macallan 12 Sherry Oak
pours.notes: Matured in sherry-seasoned oak casks from Jerez, mostly European oak. Compare it with the Lasanta.

pours.name: GlenDronach 12
pours.notes: Matured in Pedro Ximénez and oloroso casks. Put it beside the Macallan.
